title: Rollback to Version 22 – Fix account recognition and registration errors

requirements.text: Roll back the application to the state it was in at Version 22. This includes reverting all backend (main.mo) and frontend source files to their Version 22 equivalents to restore stable account recognition and registration behavior.

quotes: Change it back to version 22 it's still not recognizing I have a account and prompts me to create one then says failed to register or create

acceptanceCriteria: Existing users who previously created an account are recognized upon login via Internet Identity and are NOT prompted to create a new account.
New users who go through the profile setup flow can successfully register without receiving a 'failed to register or create' error.
The ProfileSetupModal does not appear for users who already have an existing profile.
Users can log in and access their profile, feed, and all authenticated features without errors.

constraints: Do not introduce any new features or UI changes beyond what was present in Version 22.
Do not modify immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
nonGoals: Adding new features or pages not present in Version 22.
Changing the visual design or theme.
Modifying the About page contact/Instagram section added after Version 22 unless it was not present in Version 22.
